remediationFamilies.wrong_definition_or_acronym_relation: definition/expansion relation family — emit ASKS_DEFINITION_OF / EXPANDS_AS_NON_TAX from definition intent
remediationFamilies.wrong_non_tax_relation: non-tax action family — emit label/quotation/non-tax-action relations from the requested action
remediationFamilies.wrong_negation_relation: negation family — emit NEGATES_TAX_RELEVANCE from explicit scoped negation
remediationFamilies.wrong_specific_relation: specific tax relation family — select the most specific supported relation from the tax predicate
remediationFamilies.generic_specific_conflict: specific tax relation family — generic emitted where a specific relation is required
remediationFamilies.empty_nonempty_mismatch: relation emission family — no relation emitted where one is required
remediationFamilies.wrong_cardinality_or_cooccurrence: co-occurrence family — required pair not emitted in full
